topic: Missing the arbitration clause opt-out window vs mailing the letter in time (Silas vs Marisol)

scenes.narration: Most contracts you sign quietly delete your right to ever sue in court. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom pointing at a giant contract where a line of fine print glows red, comic burst banner reads YOUR RIGHTS ERASED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas and Marisol both sign the same phone service contract.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man silas and woman marisol each signing identical contracts at a phone store counter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Page nine hides a binding arbitration clause waiving class action rights.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a contract page numbered 9 with a paragraph highlighted and labeled BINDING ARBITRATION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That clause also grants a thirty day window to opt out.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a calendar with thirty days circled in red, a small door in the page labeled OPT OUT WINDOW, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas skips the fine print and never notices the deadline.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man silas scrolling fast past walls of tiny text on a phone, a banner reads I AGREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marisol mails a dated opt out letter and keeps her receipt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marisol dropping a sealed envelope labeled ARBITRATION OPT OUT into a mailbox, holding a certified mail receipt, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two years later the company secretly overbills thousands of its customers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a corporate tower raining bills onto a crowd of angry customers, a banner reads OVERBILLED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A class action lawsuit forms, but Silas signed his rights away.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a courtroom crowd joining a filing labeled CLASS ACTION while man silas stands outside a locked courtroom door, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He must arbitrate alone before an arbitrator the company helps pick.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man silas alone at a small table facing a private arbitrator, a sign on the wall labeled PRIVATE ARBITRATION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas drops the claim because arbitration costs more than his refund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a scale tipping with a huge fee bag outweighing a tiny refund coin, man silas walking away defeated, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marisol joins the class action and collects her full refund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marisol smiling in a courtroom holding a settlement check labeled FULL REFUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Search new contracts for arbitration and mail your opt out within thirty days. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads OPT OUT WITHIN THIRTY DAYS, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
